topics.name: Ingest Release Watch digest
topics.trigger: Handoff payload from the explorer (/copilot-studio?digest=1) or the phrase analyze release watch.
topics.instructions: Accept only in use and referenced rows. Drop unused inventory (ENT-17) and unused-product flags. Require a Microsoft source_url on every row.

topics.name: Emit TicketAnalysis
topics.instructions: For each remaining flag emit a TicketAnalysis row: title, description, url, area, severity, dataverseValue (Maker Severity 644640000–644640003), effective_date, change_type (Feature|Deprecated), is_deferable, system_impact, reasoning, should_create_ticket, matched_solutions. Do not invent deprecation claims beyond the source_url page. Do not use 211460000 or 211460010.

topics.name: Create Release Ticket rows for System Administrator
topics.instructions: Create rows on cr458_releaseticket (schema name cr458_ReleaseTicket, display name Release Ticket) — not Case/incident. Map Title (cr458_title if custom, else cr458_name), description, url, area, severity, effective_date, change_type, and source_url. Set cr458_severity to TicketAnalysis.dataverseValue (Critical 644640000, High 644640001, Medium 644640002, Low 644640003). Set cr458_change_type to Feature 644640000 or Deprecated 644640001. Bind by column because Feature and Critical share 644640000. Assign Owner to a user in the System Administrator role. Do not use a Case queue. Do not create rows for unused digest flags.

tools.name: Rate TicketAnalysis
tools.input: Filtered digest row + Contoso inventory labels

tools.name: Create Release Ticket
tools.operation: Create a new Release Ticket row

bind.cr458_title: TicketAnalysis.title when primary is custom Title — confirm from column properties
bind.cr458_name: TicketAnalysis.title when Maker primary is still Name

tools.note: Configured by the admin in Copilot Studio against cr458_releaseticket. Confirm whether Title maps to cr458_title or cr458_name. The explorer never calls Dataverse.
